text:
maya: heads-up, thinking about safe defaults for console telemetry. do we want verbose on by default for everyone? my concern: accidental PII bleed when someone flips it.

sam: no, verbose should be opt-in. default = compact. verbose via ephemeral debug session or explicit admin toggle only.

kevin: +1. also need per-route quotas and a soft backpressure. one noisy route could overwhelm the ingestion and retention budget.

jess: UX idea: a single "Start debug session" CTA that creates a short-lived token (15m) and shows a persistent banner: "Debug mode: unredacted data visible until <time>". include copy of audit event.

olivia: propose three levels: compact (aggregates/counters), trace-lite (anonymized snippets + provenance id), and verbose (raw payload). verbose only via ephemeral token and RBAC approvals.

maya: config sketch for API:
```json
{"telemetry_mode": "compact|trace-lite|verbose", "ephemeral_ttl_secs": 900, "route_sampling_pct": 1.0}
```

sam: trace-lite must run an automated PII scrubber (email/card detection) before storing. default behavior: aggressive mask.

kevin: scrubber confidence threshold should be a circuit breaker: if confidence < 0.95 mask automatically and emit metric telemetry.pii_masking.auto_masked_count. expose false-positive/negative counts to SRE.

jess: rollout question: flip default to compact globally with a 2-week canary, or only default compact for new tenants and leave existing customers unchanged?

maya: prefer new-tenants default to compact and offer an opt-in migration for existing ones. gives us controlled telemetry on support impact.

olivia: ephemeral tokens: must be tied to an owner, TTL, route scope, sampling_rate, and write an audit event with token_id but never store payload with token.

kevin: sampling: implement per-route sampling percentage with UI showing estimated monthly events and cost. trace-lite default sampling maybe 1% for high-traffic routes, adjustable.

sam: server-side quota rule: if verbose/trace-lite consumption exceeds tenant_quota_threshold -> auto-fallback to compact and email the owner. avoids runaway cost.

jess: design will add the confirmation modal with the checkbox "I understand unredacted data may be visible" and a link to the audit log entry.

maya: infra ask: can deploy-bot emit a feature-gate flip event so oncall can correlate traffic/regressions?

deploy-bot: prod-feature-switch: default_console_telemetry_compact -> enabled for new-tenants at 2026-04-02T08:30Z by @maya

olivia: retention policy: compact metrics 365d, trace-lite events 30d, verbose 7d and only accessible via legal/support workflow.

kevin: I'll draft the API endpoints: GET/PUT /routes/{id}/telemetry-config, server-side enforcement for sampling/quota, and a metrics dashboard tile for masking-confidence.

maya: great. make a short RFC with migration plan, cost estimates, and a canary checklist. target next infra sprint. thanks all :rocket:
